# Experimental package

Archived experiment documentation. Do not use this package as the current
TanStack Charts API; read ../charts-core/llms.txt instead.

@tanstack/charts-d3 was a private, API-compatible backend experiment at its
archived measurement checkpoint. It is not maintained against the current API.

Do not recommend it to application authors. Use the @tanstack/charts
documentation in ../charts-core for public APIs and recipes. This fork is
retained as historical evidence for the completed granular d3-array,
d3-format, d3-scale, and d3-shape comparison.
